onboardingEvidence.provenanceEvidence: The official careers page's All open positions link goes to careers.nordicsemi.com. Its Engineering and other discipline links point to the same board. Use the unfiltered jobs endpoint.
onboardingEvidence.countEvidence: A direct live read of /jobs publishes 15 jobs and 15 unique posting links, exactly matching all JSON item URLs. Page 2 at per_page=100 is empty. The web search/open cache showed 14; the live HTML includes Engineering Manager, Cloud Platform – nRF Cloud, also present in JSON.
onboardingEvidence.pagination: GET, top-level keys version, title, home_page_url, feed_url, items. One-based page and per_page parameters are honored: per_page=5&page=2 returns the next five items. Full descriptions are inline in content_html.
onboardingEvidence.identityEvidence: Embedded Software Engineer: Kraków, PL, description names Nordic nRF Connect SDK and Software Platform Group. Platform Engineer, nRF Cloud - Oslo: Oslo, NO, description explicitly names Nordic Semiconductor and nRF Cloud. Product Engineer: Muntinlupa, PH.
onboardingEvidence.locationMappingNote: The existing generic mapping preserves the first published address. Multi-location roles include Field Application Engineer (San Jose and San Francisco) and Regional Sales Manager, Partners, Central (Austin, Dallas, Chicago and Minneapolis).
onboardingEvidence.countryEvidence: The official About page explicitly gives headquarters in Trondheim, Norway.
onboardingEvidence.robotsEvidence: User-Agent * disallows /app/, /messages/, /messenger/, /facebook/tab/ and /jobs/internal/; public jobs and JSON paths are not disallowed. Override remains enabled.
onboardingEvidence.notes: Terminal fetch of www.nordicsemi.com/Careers and the older /About-us/Career path returned HTTP 403. Web browsing reads the official provenance page, and careers.nordicsemi.com HTML and JSON return HTTP 200; this is not a blocked employer.
